the secret pre-arrangement of communication time can be a powerful covert communication tool, and that it is worth investing in the secrecy of such pre-arrangements.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the LPD communication is possible with the help of a secret key.

we show how to use a secret shared key to pre-arrange a time slot for LPD communication, and how to transmit a large amount of covert information in this slot.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, unlike standard security methods that are designed to protect information that is already known to the adversary, covert communication methods can be designed to prevent the adversary from even learning that information was sent in the first place.
LPD communication is not only about hiding the information contained in the transmission, but about hiding the fact that a transmission is even taking place.
LPD communication can be significantly more efficient than standard covert communication when the wader does not know when the communication will take place.
